tasks.result:
## Outcome
Done. The buggy function is `applyDiscount`, and the one-line fix is below.

## Findings
- `/tmp/v3orch/w/t1/src/pricing.ts:5-7`: `applyDiscount(cents, pct)` returns `Math.round(cents * (1 - pct))`. The comment on line 6 says `pct` is a whole number (10 = 10%), but the code treats it as a fraction. With `pct = 10`, the result is `cents * -9`.
- Fix (line 7): `return Math.round(cents * (1 - pct / 100));`

## Verification
- Read `/tmp/v3orch/w/t1/src/pricing.ts` in full (12 lines). Confirmed the bug at lines 6-7.
- No files were edited. I only used the Read tool.

## Open issues
None. The fix assumes every caller passes `pct` as a whole number, as the comment says. I did not check callers, since Q1 only covers this file.
